scripts.build: pnpm --filter typegpu-confetti build && pnpm --filter test-web-app build
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.ci: pnpm check && pnpm build && pnpm smoke && pnpm expo:check
scripts.expo:check: pnpm --filter test-app run doctor && pnpm --filter test-app run export:check
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter typegpu-confetti typecheck && pnpm --filter test-web-app typecheck && pnpm --filter test-app typecheck
